notes.title: Elle is available now!
notes.content:
The long-awaited release of Elle has taken place.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/937930/Elle/

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
The game has become more friendly to the players.
[list]
[*] Levels now have a checkpoint (except for 1 and 13). You can load into a save point via the pause menu, or continue the game from that position if you die.
[*] Fixed some issues with keyboard controls.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43398351/0e77158ff559500d9d202474564fb61b5fadd6ae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43398351/22ec0a8b83c2738d3d88fbe98fe19d39e9938f00.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved gamepad controls.
[*] The game pause menu now shows control keys.
[*] Hints have been added to the second level.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43398351/a9d05675216105c42cfcc7264ab4a155c562665a.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43398351/ebd2f513eeb883db7077496f5e14ee96275fcffc.png[/img]

Added function "magic pill" - increases the speed of the game by 25%.
By default, the function is activated with the Shift or LT keys.
[i]Note: user control settings will unfortunately be reset to their original values.[/i]

Fixed control issues when using the keyboard.

notes.title: Have you written a review?
notes.content:
Please don't forget to write a review after finishing the game.
The fate of [b]Elle[/b] directly depends on you.
